title: announce_store: corrupt state records permanently consume durable capacity slots
description: Found by edge-cases codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-t8ox (P3). rust/lichen-node/src/announce_store.rs:425-443 (name filter at 438): count_durable_state_records is name-based, so a state record that fails seal verification or the length check (234, 251) still consumes a durable slot forever: load() -> Corrupt, accept() -> Corrupt (via load), and there is deliberately no removal API. 64 such files wedge the store Full for new pins permanently; recovery is only manual file deletion + reopen (recount). Conservative by design (never undercounts) but the recount skews above the number of SERVABLE records with no quarantine or self-heal path. Requires local filesystem write access to trigger (which also permits worse), so low severity. Fix direction when picked up: on load() Corrupt, either quarantine-rename the offending file (e.g. dot-prefix, excluded by the recount filter) or subtract a per-open tally of load-failed records from the capacity gate - quarantine is the simpler fail-safe (record is unforgeable-sealed garbage either way).
